title: One booking agency controls the bands
summary: The business is harder today because a single booking agency controls bands and there is no competition.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: How the music business changed: hype, youth and lost apprenticeship

blocks.x: I see. So, what about the -- no really radical changes in the management of problems because the interpersonal problems are still interpersonal problems.
Because I'm thinking about the business of it, the aspects of --

Well, actually, the business end of it is more difficult today. I would say so, because there's no competitive spirit in the business as a business, none. In other words, there's one booking agency that controls all bands.
It's really not healthy. But it's not healthy for people to want to go into a business that doesn't have a number of bands.
(Unintelligible). But without them, I don't think there would be anything.
